text:
Sam: Heads-up: noticed two posted invoices in NetSuite for the same Stripe invoice in EUR for ACCT-120 (one for €1,234.56 and another for €1,234.00). Looks like a rounding/dupe.
Priya: Can you drop the NS/Stripe IDs?
Sam: NS: https://ns.example.com/app/accounting/transactions/invoice.nl?id=662211
Sam: Stripe invoice: in_7Z9c... amount_due=€0, lines show charges 1234.56 and prorate -0.56. Stripe only has one invoice.
Emily: Which job wrote the second invoice? dlq replays, nightly-sync, or realtime?
Sam: Trace shows first created by realtime webhooks sync at 03:12Z, second created at 03:14Z by dlq-processor retry job 9912. dlq logs show previous attempt timed out and requeued with linear-backoff.
Zane: I pulled dlq-9912 logs: our retry path used a 2nd attempt with request id changed and we attempt create/invoice with payload where we normalize amounts to USD for internal mapping, then convert back to EUR using a cached FX rate that was updated in the 2-minute window. The cached FX drifted (1234.56 vs 1234.00 after conversion) so NetSuite saw a different total and our external_id generation included amount_rounded which created a different external_id and bypassed NetSuite dedupe.
Priya: So external_id included rounded amount -> different external_id -> NetSuite accepted a second invoice. That produced double posted revenue.
Netsuite-admin: Both invoices already posted to GL. I can create journal to reverse but Finance needs to approve adjustments > €500. ACCT-120 is €1,234.56.
Billing-bot: dlq-processor 9912 retry count 3 -> created invoice id 662212, logs ref f3b1 :warning:
Zane: Immediate mitigation plan:
1) Disable dlq auto-retry for billing queue (5m) to stop more duplicates.
2) Hotfix: remove amount from external_id; use Stripe invoice.id + customer.id as canonical key (10-15m).
3) Run a sanitizer to find pairs with same stripe_invoice_id in NS and mark duplicates for manual review.
4) Longer: make FX lookup strongly consistent during retry (lock or TTL refresh) and add unit tests.
Priya: I approve reversing manual entry for ACCT-120 (<= €2,000). Please file FIN-3512 for audit trail.
Netsuite-admin: I'll create reversing journal and link to original invoices but will wait for FIN ticket id in notes.
Sam: I've paused dlq auto-retry at 2298765380.
Billing-bot: dlq:billing requeue disabled by sam at 2298765380 :ok_hand:
Zane: Hotfix PR created: fix/external-id-fx (https://git.example.com/r/redwood/billing/pulls/433). Changes: external_id = "stripe_inv:{invoice.id}"; FX lookups locked for 2m per invoice.
Zane: Deploying hotfix to prod now. ETA 12m.
Emily: I'll run a one-off query to find NetSuite records that reference the same stripe invoice id and list candidates for reversal.
Emily: Query results: found 4 duplicates across 3 accounts totalling €3,920. Attached list to FIN-3512.
Priya: Approve manual reversal for duplicates under €2,000 per account. For anything >€2,000 we require CFO sign-off. Two accounts exceed that — flagging FIN-3512 for CFO review.
Netsuite-admin: Reversal journal created for ACCT-120 and linked to FIN-3512 at 2298765438.
Zane: Hotfix deployed and live at 2298765445, CI green :rocket: Re-enabled dlq with safe-policy: single manual retry until confirmed.
Billing-bot: deploy:hotfix/external-id-fx pushed by zane at 2298765445
Sam: Monitoring ledger and will reconcile once journals post.
Priya: Thanks. Owners: Zane (code + deploy), Netsuite-admin (journals + voids), Emily (investigation + FIN ticket), Sam (monitoring). Target: duplicates resolved and FIN-3512 updated within 24h.
Netsuite-admin: Reconciled ledger entry for ACCT-120 posted at 2298765450.
Sam: All good on my side; closing once CFO signs remaining >€2k cases.
Priya: Filing FIN-3512 and adding root cause + remediation notes.
